summary: Makes staging delivery guidance require exact retained-release compatibility refresh and incident-bound recovery for retained mutation locks.
userImpact: Staging drain preparation no longer treats a lifecycle classification as compatibility evidence.
A retained staging mutation lock is recovered only after the exact failed run, artifacts, live generation, route and failed execution are reverified.

instructions: Reinstall version 0.1.10 of the EnterpriseGlue development-workflows plugin after merging this change.

security: The guidance preserves retained locks on uncertain failure and permits takeover only for exact reviewed incident evidence.
documentation: Updates the staging-delivery skill and maintained workflow-plugin guide.
knownLimitations: The skill selects the maintained Cloud workflows; executable recovery identities remain fixed in the Cloud repository.
rollback: Revert the plugin guidance and version bump; this does not alter deployed Cloud resources.
validation: Run the bundled plugin tests, official Codex skill and plugin validators, documentation-boundary guard, and release-note validation.
